name: search_tickets
description: Searches customer support tickets by title, description, category, or ID
output: list of ticket objects matching query

name: get_ticket
description: Retrieves a specific customer support ticket by its exact ticket ID

name: list_tickets
description: Lists all support tickets in the system with optional status or priority filtering

name: summarize_ticket
description: Generates a concise 1-line summary of ticket description using AI reasoning rules

name: classify_priority
description: Classifies ticket priority into High, Medium, or Low based on critical keywords

name: generate_reply
description: Generates a structured, empathetic, and actionable customer support response

name: apply_guardrails
description: Evaluates inputs and outputs for sensitive keywords, fraud detection, and safety compliance
output: guardrails assessment object including human review flag

name: evaluate_response
description: Scores agent response quality out of 3 points based on length, completeness, and priority correctness
output: evaluation score object (X/3) with detailed breakdown
